cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I gave your fern one spoonful, just like you did. That's the watering you asked me for.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was plant food. I need you to water every pot each day until Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A spoonful of water in every pot, every day. All covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Use the jug, not the spoon. Fill it up and share it between the pots.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One full jug shared out today, then. Tomorrow I'll go back to the spoon; you didn't say the jug was every day.
